bundle.description: The approved bundle, when the turn approved one.

draft.description: The draft, with its rendered files.

rules.description: Counts of evidence-gated items. Always emitted by this engine; optional on the wire.

state.description: The state to send with the next turn: opaque, bounded at about 1 MB.

summary.description:
What the model said of the turn when it ended it with `finish`: what it did, what it
left out and why, and how it answered each comment (the comments themselves are
answered, so the state no longer holds them). `None` when the turn ended otherwise.

AgentVersion.description:
What built a bundle; see [`ApprovedBundle`]. A bundle Anthropic's Claude drafted, on
Helix's key or a workspace's own, names no provider, as every bundle before contract 4.0.0
does, so an engine of then still reads it.

model.description: The model, as the request named it.

provider.description: The kind of provider that served the model; none for Anthropic's own API.

ApprovedBundle.description: An approved version: what drives `ingest-mapped` and extraction.

impact.description: What approving it changes in loaded data.

parent.description: The version it was built from.

review_json.description: `review.json`: rationale, competency questions, gaps and what was left out.

Basis.description: What an item rests on, which the policy gates read.

oneOf.description: What the link descriptions and the user's workflow mean.
How the process works, as a user stated it.
What the data showed; never enough for a rule.

CardRow.description:
The source and mapping of rows behind a counterexample's premises. A card never names the
rows: their identities are source data.

oneOf.description: A type no link, mapping or competency question uses.
A resolve-only keyed type has no row-filled names or identifiers.
A type named like a data value: all capitals (`LAX`) or with digits (`B737`).
A link with the same endpoint types as another and a similar name or description.
A type, link or mapping that serves no competency question, key or join.

A name against the rules: UpperCamel singular types; snake_case links, relations,
properties, rules and constraints.
A description of more than one sentence, or a rationale of more than three.
An email or phone pattern in a name, description, question or rationale.
A data-like token in a description or question.

Clues.description:
Whom an `[enrichments]` item could look up, as `check_draft` measured it over the turn's
tables with the create passes a load runs ([`ingest::clues`]): what the website's
confidence reads (High at 80% usable or more and none shared, Medium at 50% or more, Low
below). A person needs a full name ([`extraction::text::full_name`]) to be usable, as the
load's planner does; its other filters (free mail, role mailboxes, LinkedIn URLs it can't
read) aren't applied. Stored on the item until the item, a type or a mapping changes.

conflicting.description: Those with a clue left out because it holds two values.

email.description: Those with a work email to look them up by.

linkedin_url.description: Those with a LinkedIn URL to look them up by.

no_name.description:
Those without a full name, whom no load looks up: none of the type's `names` props has a
value, or together they give fewer than two words of letters.

people.description: The entities of the item's type the tables create.

shared.description: Those with a clue value left out because another entity holds it too.

usable.description:
Those with a full name, two words of letters or more, and at least one clue: whom a load
could look up.

Counterexample.description: A bounded counterexample with its proof and row provenance. Source values are untrusted.

fact.description: The violated constraint or contradicted fact, with sample entity identities.

proof.description: Proof steps in premise order, with sample entity identities.

rows.description: Rows behind the proof's stated facts and types.

Draft.description:
A draft ontology and its mappings, as items. It always validates: every write that would
leave it invalid is refused whole.

It serializes with each item's snippet as canonical TOML and its lint; deserializing parses
every snippet again, checks the ontology, rules and CQ paths (the mappings' catalog isn't at
hand; [`SessionState::validate`](crate::SessionState::validate) checks against it) and
computes the lint afresh.

lint.description: Written for readers; recomputed on reading.

DraftView.description: A draft with its rendered files.

Effect.description: What an item's change needs done to loaded data.

oneOf.description: Mapped sources load again.
Text is extracted again.
Rules are compiled again.
Stored data no longer fits.

ErrorKind.description: What kind of check refused an item.

oneOf.description:
The snippet doesn't define exactly its item, or the draft's structure breaks: a part
without its link, a gap in a link's chains, a reference to a CQ that isn't there, a
repeated id.
The item isn't in the draft (or the question isn't open).
The user locked the item.
The user removed the item, so it can't come back without asking.

A name, description or rationale carries data: an email or phone pattern, a source's
display name, or a sampled value.

A policy gate refused it, before any evidence: a rule's basis, a `block` constraint's
basis, a raw rule a declaration expresses.
It cites an evidence id the session doesn't hold.
`schema::Ontology::from_toml` refused the rendered ontology.
`rules::Program::compile` refused it.
`mapping::Mappings::from_toml` or `validate` refused the rendered mappings.
A competency question's path doesn't follow the ontology's links.
The session state would pass its size bound.

EvidenceCard.description:
The evidence for one item, computed over the current row sample and document preview.
All counts describe that sample; no full-data estimate is made without a sampling ratio.

confirmed.description: Attributed facts that are both stated and derived.

contradicted.description: Added facts with a complete head for their subject.

failure_rate_bound.description: 95% Wilson upper failure bound, or min(1, 3/n) with zero failures.

precision.description: Confirmed / (confirmed + contradicted), absent when the denominator is zero.

rev.description: Draft revision measured, before the harness records this card.

review_facts.description: Facts implicated in blocking violations (dry-run review effect).

sample.description: Explicit sampling basis; never a claim about all source data.

subjects.description: Distinct eligible subjects for a constraint.

unmeasurable.description: No attributed fact has a complete head.

unmeasured.description: What the counts leave out, if anything.

unrepresentable.description: Attributed relation facts that no link can represent.

violation_rate.description: Distinct violating subjects divided by eligible subjects, when measured.

violations.description: Violations caused or cleared, by constraint and requested severity.

EvidenceId.description:
The id of a stored tool result, such as `e17`: every number the user sees cites one.
Ids order by number.

acknowledged.description: Whether it was acknowledged as intended.

FindingKey.description: One finding: what an acknowledged finding is known by.

Gate.description: A policy gate that needs evidence from the data, which the harness computes and fills.

oneOf.description:
A rule or declaration: no contradiction, support of at least 20 (or unmeasurable with a
definitional basis), no new `block` violation, all from the current revision.
A constraint: its violations in the data; `block` needs none.

`cardinality = "one"` or `required`: dry-run counts back it, or the user saw what it
sends to review.

Impact.description: One item's effect on data already loaded; see [`ApprovedBundle`].

ItemError.description: One reason a write was refused.

item.description: The item that caused it; `None` when the error names none, so the batch as a whole.

message.description: What is wrong, as the check put it.

ItemId.description:
One item of a draft: a piece of `ontology.toml` or `mappings.toml`, or a competency question
or gap of the review. Together the items cover both files, each piece in exactly one item:

| Item | Owns |
|---|---|
| `type.T` | all of `[types.T]` |
| `link.l` | `from`, `to`, `description`, `props` and `identity` of `[links.l]` |
| `link.l.cardinality` | `cardinality = "one"` (the default `many` is no item) |
| `link.l.required` | `required = true` |
| `link.l.implies.t` | `t` in `implies` |
| `link.l.inverse_of` | `inverse_of` |
| `link.l.symmetric`, `link.l.transitive` | `symmetric = true`, `transitive = true` |
| `link.l.chain.a.b` | the chain `["a", "b"]` in `chain` |
| `relation.r` | `description` of `[relations.r]`; its declarations are `relation.r.implies.t` and so on, as for links |
| `rule.r`, `constraint.c` | all of `[rules.r]`, `[constraints.c]` |
| `mapping.m` | all of `[mappings.m]`, its bindings included |
| `extraction.name` | all of `[extractions.name]`, its document selector, types and links |
| `enrichment.name` | all of `[enrichments.name]`: People enrichment of one type |
| `cq.ID`, `gap.ID` | a competency question, a gap (review data, in no file) |

The file headers (`version`, and `ontology` in `mappings.toml`) belong to no item: the
harness sets them.

ItemRepr.description: An item as the state stores it: its snippet as canonical TOML.

clues.description: An `enrichment.<name>` item's measured clues; never on another item.

ItemStatus.description: Where an item is in review.

oneOf.description: The agent wrote it.
The user wrote it, with an `Edit`.
The user approved it.

LeftOut.description: A field, object or source left out of the draft, and why.

what.description: What: a source id, then an object and field when it is one of those.

ModelFailure.description: Why a model call failed for good, as the contract's model failures name it.

oneOf.description: The model declined the request.
The provider was unavailable, overloaded or broke off, retries included.
The provider refused the API key.
The key may not use the model.
The provider has no such model.
The provider kept limiting the rate of calls, retries included.
The account is out of credit or quota.
The request is too long for the model.

The model or endpoint can't do what the request asks (tool calls, structured answers),
or refused it as invalid.
The answer hit the output limit.

The answer couldn't be read: not the JSON asked for, or a stream that broke its
protocol.
The call ran out of time.
The model's weights changed since it was tested.
The endpoint resolves to a private address.

ProviderKind.description:
The kind of provider a workspace's models run on: which API they are reached through, and
so which wire, catalog rows and failure copy apply. Every kind the contract declares is
here, whether or not this build can reach it yet.

oneOf.description: Anthropic's Messages API.
OpenAI's Responses API.
An Azure OpenAI resource's v1 API.
Amazon Bedrock's Converse API.
An Ollama server's native API.
A server speaking OpenAI's Chat Completions or Responses API.

Question.description: A question the agent asked the user. Its `default`, when it has options, is one of them.

RuleCounts.description:
Number of rule/constraint items and inference declarations and how many have an accepted evaluation.
The backend copies this into `Definition.rules` and requires `evaluated == count` to load.

evaluated.description: Those with a harness verdict that permits the executable item (refusals excluded).

RuleVerdict.description: The executable outcome of evaluation. A refused item remains gated until removed or fixed.

oneOf.description: A definitional/process rule, or a constraint permitted at its requested severity.

A constraint permitted at most as a warning: the harness rewrites a `block` one to
`severity = "warn"`, and a `warn` or `info` one keeps its severity.
The item cannot be used as written.

Serves.description:
What an item is for: a competency question, an entity key, or a join between sources.
Every type, link and mapping traces to at least one ([`Check::Untraced`](crate::Check)).

oneOf.description: The agent finished.
The agent asked questions.

The revision was approved and the bundle emitted; the state's draft builds on the
bundle's version from then on, so a later approval is its child.
A cap was hit; the last valid draft is kept and `Continue` resumes.
A source kept failing; the backend may refresh its credentials.
The model failed.
The input was invalid: nothing changed.
The input was for another revision: nothing changed.

Unmeasured.description:
What a card's counts leave out. A constraint with any is capped at `warn`; a rule missing
rows it needs is refused.

oneOf.description:
Rows the item needs are missing from the latest dry run's sample: those of a mapping
that can fill it or, for a rule, those that state a head it derived about its subject.
A document set a route that can fill the item reads has no preview.
Both of those.
Revise had no comparable load to measure on.
Some of the load's entities were over the read budget.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache.

ViolationDelta.description: A constraint's before/after counts at its requested severity.

constraint.description: Constraint id as displayed by the rules engine.
